subject: All branches and all workers jointly advance semantic preconnection, GWT emergence observability/control, with FRANK proposal-only self-observation boundary

delta.shared_mission: Every substantive worker in every registered branch contributes branch-local work, falsification, measurement, implementation, counterexample or evidence-backed NO_CHANGE toward the autonomous semantic coupling fabric and GWT-emergence-control mission, while remaining loyal to its research domain.
delta.architecture: ClayCode makes dependencies semantic; UnifiedDB keeps canonical identity/dependencies incrementally current; Hyperposition preserves alternatives/higher-order codependencies; ClayGraph exposes current derived topology; GWT makes use/outcome/re-entry observable; Emergenz tests higher-order causal claims; Harness executes/falsifies; bounded interventions may learn control laws.
delta.frank_boundary: FRANK may detect problems in its own Harness, form hypotheses and produce concrete improvement proposals. Every such proposal preserves ORIGIN=FRANK_SELF_OBSERVATION, AUTHORITY=PROPOSAL_ONLY, EXECUTION=RESEARCH_ENTITY_ONLY, SELF_CHANGE_ALLOWED=false. FRANK may never patch, migrate, promote, apply or indirectly delegate modification of its own Harness. The separate Clay Research Entity independently reviews, rejects/refines/tests and authorizes any implementation.
delta.anti_bypass: High ClayGraph activation, GWT ignition, EmergenceReadout, learned control policy, different tool/process/agent or automatic work generation cannot upgrade FRANK proposal authority into self-change authority.
delta.same_room: When multiple workers share a room, decompose the branch-local mission into complementary CHEF/ABYSS/FORGE/CARTOGRAPHER/REPLICATOR/SYNTHESIZER lanes; role grants no truth or self-change authority.
